verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual documents on-device commits from the Status tab, with hunk-level staging, amend, AI-suggested messages and signed commits. Push is a distinct action that works offline-then-online, Auto-Sync handles committing and pushing automatically, and https/ssh protocols with Secure Enclave SSH keys support pushing to many hosts. A community user independently confirms pulling, editing and pushing from the iOS app while commuting.
